etsy.title: Rally Sticker Gravel Snow Tarmac, Motorsport Vinyl Decal, Rally Driver Gift, Racing Laptop Sticker
etsy.description:
A rally sticker showing the three stage surfaces: Gravel, Snow, and Tarmac, stacked as bold words with a surfaces graphic.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in. That's the full print area: the sticker is cut around the design shape, so it measures less than the full square
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, toolbox lid kept indoors, notebook, or garage cabinet. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy rally sticker market is dominated by custom driver name stickers and number decals for actual cars, not humor or typographic stickers.
Funny racing stickers on Etsy are mostly slogans and F1/JDM-themed designs; rally-specific humor stickers are rare.
Single rally decals on Etsy are priced from about $3 to $12.
Amazon rally stickers are mostly performance lettering decals and stripe kits for actual vehicles, not indoor laptop stickers.
Multi-sticker packs of racing-themed designs for laptops and water bottles are common and cheap per sticker on Amazon.
